## Token Efficiency Without Lowering Quality (owner, 2026-10-18)

Owner: be very efficient without compromising quality, in every session. Lessons
from W1 rework and W2-00..W2-03 (about 30-40% avoidable rework, then 15-20%):

- **All acceptance rules in the brief from the start.** Layout contract,
  recurring-defect checklist, height rule, plain-language rules, proof list.
  Never introduce a rule mid-build; it forces trimming passes on every slice.
- **Build specs answer the known question classes before coding.** A W2+ build
  spec is ready only when it fixes, against the actual code: identifier
  grammars and formats; exact fixture Site/Foundation values and how bindings
  are published; every seam with path:symbol; guard allowlists the new code
  must satisfy (rule 8 writers, sqlalchemy import allowlist, dependency
  direction); refusal codes; freshness/time references; UI empty/unavailable
  copy and the panel map; how Lab/run projections and stored artifacts look.
  W2-02 needed six question rounds because its first spec skipped these.
- **Size builder runs to one spec commit each**, with a handoff after each, so
  no run dies mid-commit and the next run reads only the handoff.
- **Model by risk.** First review of a new build and design-deciding work on
  the session model; fix rounds, re-reviews (scoped to prior findings) and
  mechanical steps on Sonnet. A capture- or copy-only fix may be verified by
  the coordinator directly (view the evidence, record a short verify note).
- **Serialize slices that edit the same shared UI files**; parallelize only
  disjoint work (backend vs frontend, different domains).
- **One full suite per round, only when no builder is running.** Do not rerun
  full suites after doc-, test- or CSS-only changes; rerun the touched files.
- **Batch Architect/Planner questions into one Codex call**, and fold a
  preemptive sweep of the slice's remaining commits into that same call.
- **No duplicate agents.** Check for a live agent on a worktree before
  dispatching; never reuse a worktree a reviewer is still using.
- **Briefs point to files; they do not restate them.** Coordinator replies to
  interim agent notifications stay to one line.

## 8. Slice fixtures, replay and vendor peer

### Writer, trigger and transaction contract

The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.

Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, then add `ev_consequence_work,ev_consequence_work_attempt` to the same `$consequenceTables` array. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and appends work attempts. Migration triggers alone insert work; the consequence writer appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically with consequence/links or a `FAILED` attempt with error code. Work and attempts are append-only; runtime work INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are rejected. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `financials/recompute.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and successful work-attempt append. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 message-only conflict target, per-ordinal savepoint/reread precedence and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work-attempt append, rejects runtime work INSERT, immutable work/attempt UPDATE or DELETE, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.

`0026` adds append-only `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, created_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`) and `ev_consequence_work_attempt` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, work_id scoped FK, attempt_no int>0, outcome `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, error_code nullable, started_at, finished_at; UNIQUE `(work_id,attempt_no)`, partial unique successful attempt per work). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` selects unfinished work lacking a successful attempt, takes an advisory transaction lock per work ID, writes a Site window revision and links, and appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically; failure appends `FAILED` and remains retryable. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

## Commit (4) exact contract

**Replay storage and API.** Add read-only `ColdReplayService` in `backend/assetops_backend/cold_replay.py`, backed by an injected read-only Postgres adapter and `SimulationRunRepository`; no SQL belongs in the API or a new writer. `build_cold_replay_router` mounts `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/cold/replay?run_id=<id>` only under the Lab gate. Require exactly one nonempty `run_id`; missing/extra/unknown query keys answer 422 `COLD_REPLAY_PARAMETER_INVALID`. Use the existing `Access(request,site_code)` seam and an owner-role check supplied by production composition: 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` for foreign tenant or role, 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND`/`RUN_NOT_FOUND` for an admitted caller's unknown Site/run. A selected run must belong to the authenticated tenant and Site, have the cold model/publication/observation pair and a registered basis; never read a different run's lineage. The development access function is for injected tests only; no production owner principal means 403, not an implicit operator grant. A registered publication for the run with another source class is excluded, and an inaccessible source gate returns 403. Run-store/ledger read failure, corrupt run or a missing persisted run referenced by a publication returns 503 `COLD_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`; do not infer profile data from publications. A valid persisted cold run with no publications returns 200 with `publication_id:null`, empty arrays and SHA-256 of canonical `[]`.

The response has exactly `publication_id` (latest UUID string or null), `publication_ids` (UUID strings), `run_profile:{model_profile:{profile_id,profile_version},publication_profile:{profile_id,profile_version},observation_profile:{profile_id,profile_version}}`, `scenario_digest` (frozen SHA), `batch_ids` (external Batch V2 IDs), `receipts` (one `{batch_id,accepted,duplicate,rejected,conflict}` per linked batch), `accepted_record_ids` (UUID strings for `ACCEPTED` dispositions only), and `public_digest`. Order publications by `(evidence_publication.recorded_at,evidence_publication.id)` and linked batches by that order; an unlinked publication is a valid pending release and contributes its ID but no batch/receipt/accepted IDs; a linked batch that is `IN_PROGRESS` or has incomplete dispositions is a 503 `COLD_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`, never a partial completed receipt. Use `batch_publication_link` on all scoped IDs and `ingestion_batch`, then `ingestion_disposition` by `(batch_id,ordinal)`; recompute all four counts from dispositions, never `ingestion_batch` cached totals. `accepted_record_ids` includes the first accepted ID at its accepted ordinal and excludes duplicate references; `CONFLICT` is counted separately from `REJECTED`. For each disposition, parse the canonical `ingestion_batch.batch_text` Batch V2 and take the envelope at its ordinal, SHA-256 its canonical UTF-8 text, then append the JSON array `[external_batch_id,ordinal,envelope_sha256,decision,accepted_evidence_id_or_null]` to the ordered digest input. `public_digest=SHA-256(UTF8(canonical_json(that array)))`. A rejected/conflict row uses null for this final element; a duplicate uses its referenced accepted ID. Refuse missing ordinals, invalid canonical batch text, mismatched batch commitment or scope as 503. This digest commits to public envelopes and dispositions only; no private trajectory, forcing, report payload or run truth appears in the API.

Its calls are `foundation_revision(tenant_id: UUID, site_record_id: UUID, revision_id: UUID) -> RevisionRow | None` (select the exact ID from `FoundationStore.revisions`) and `cold_scenario(scenario_id: str, version: int) -> ColdScenarioDefinition | None` (read `ScenarioCatalogService.get_scenario`, require exact version and cold type). Compose from the same Foundation/scenario stores used by `create_app`, including test overrides. A missing port, missing or unreadable record, or any `verify_cold_inputs` mismatch becomes `LabControlRefused("FROZEN_RUN_NOT_RECONSTRUCTIBLE", run.run_id, detail)` before Stage, schedule or gateway admission. No current-head or fixture fallback.

For a cold run, `start` verifies frozen inputs and executes the whole inclusive minute-boundary interval `[19:00,20:00]` once: 61 boundaries, 60 minutes. Return a terminal `LabProjection`: `status=COMPLETED`, `boundaries_completed=boundaries_total=61`, `offset_minutes=60`, `simulation_time=interval_end_time=2026-10-06T20:00:00Z`, `interval_start_time=2026-10-06T19:00:00Z`, `timestep_minutes=1`, frozen seed and profile IDs/versions, existing kernel/numeric/contract constants, `inputs_identity=run_identity_sha256(run)`, `content_digest=SHA-256(canonical_json(["cold-thermal/1", ordered exact private minute-record documents]))`, and `observation_series_digest=SHA-256(canonical_json(ordered DeviceReport V2 texts))` including held reports before release. The minute-record document is `{at,before,after,heat_kwh,cool_kwh,records}` for each `ColdTransition` in order, including closing boundary; `before`/`after` serialize every `ColdState` dataclass field by name, and `records` every `PublicRecord` dataclass field by name. Render `datetime` as UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, `Fraction` as reduced `numerator/denominator`, tuples as arrays, booleans/integers/strings/null as their JSON types. One cold adapter renderer supplies both digest and private artifact; never derive it from product evidence. `private_state`, `observations`, `signals`, `reporting_gaps`, `recent_reports` are empty tuples; `reported_count` is all generated reports including held, `suppressed_by_gap_count=dropped_count=0`, `failure=electrical=None` on success. Notes state that the cold details live in the private artifact and gateway Stage, so empty legacy views make no claim about the physical trajectory. The Draft projection has the same frozen identities/timing, `NOT_STARTED`, zero completed boundaries, empty-series digest, no content digest and empty views; it must bypass legacy `_reporting_for`/`_model_for`. After cold `start`, `step` and `run_to_end` refuse `ALREADY_TERMINAL`; before it, both refuse `NOT_STARTED`.

Persist through `JsonExecutionArtifacts` with a distinct schema marker `artifact_schema_version: 6`, `execution_kind: COLD`, `run_identity_sha256`, scenario and observation SHA, the complete-window projection fields/digests and report count. `render_projection`/`parse_projection` must round-trip and strictly validate these; old schemas 1-5 keep their bytes, and damaged/future cold artifacts read `ARTIFACT_UNREADABLE`. Keep minute records/history in that private artifact only; a cold history read uses an explicit cold private document or an honest `HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE` result, never the legacy electrical history. `_execution_status` must read `COMPLETED` from the artifact after restart before `release_registered`; a live handle alone is insufficient. Write a terminal `COMPLETED` artifact only after ordinary Stage admission reaches the closing instant. If staging refuses after the world executes, persist a terminal `FAILED` cold projection with `ExecutionFailure.kind=PUBLICATION_REFUSED`, the computed digests and the refusal detail; `_execution_status=FAILED` blocks Commit. Do not leave a staged partial run with no artifact that Start could execute again.

The cold `_stage_registered_virtual` branch passes `ColdReport.report_text` directly to `RegisteredGatewayPublisher.publish_in_boundary_order`, grouping ordinary reports by ascending `published_at=source_time+3 seconds` and preserving report order inside a group. Each held report becomes `DelayedReport` with its unchanged report text/source time and `scheduled_release_at=2026-10-06T20:10:00Z`; use a stable `delay_event_id` derived from its report key. Set schedule `world_reached_instant=2026-10-06T20:00:03Z`, `world_complete=True`, `world_boundaries_completed=61`; pass ordinary instants to existing `_release`. The held 19:20 report remains pending until `advance_publication(run,"2026-10-06T20:10:00Z")`; gateway stamps that release as `published_at`, retains 19:20 `source_time`, and deduplicates retries by report key. A missing durable schedule after execution refuses, rather than rebuilding from the world.

## Commit (4) exact contract

**Replay storage and API.** Add read-only `ColdReplayService` in `backend/assetops_backend/cold_replay.py`, backed by an injected read-only Postgres adapter and `SimulationRunRepository`; no SQL belongs in the API or a new writer. `build_cold_replay_router` mounts `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/cold/replay?run_id=<id>` only under the Lab gate. Require exactly one nonempty `run_id`; missing/extra/unknown query keys answer 422 `COLD_REPLAY_PARAMETER_INVALID`. Use the existing `Access(request,site_code)` seam and an owner-role check supplied by production composition: 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` for foreign tenant or role, 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND`/`RUN_NOT_FOUND` for an admitted caller's unknown Site/run. A selected run must belong to the authenticated tenant and Site, have the cold model/publication/observation pair and a registered basis; never read a different run's lineage. The development access function is for injected tests only; no production owner principal means 403, not an implicit operator grant. A registered publication for the run with another source class is excluded, and an inaccessible source gate returns 403. Run-store/ledger read failure, corrupt run or a missing persisted run referenced by a publication returns 503 `COLD_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`; do not infer profile data from publications. A valid persisted cold run with no publications returns 200 with `publication_id:null`, empty arrays and SHA-256 of canonical `[]`.

The response has exactly `publication_id` (latest UUID string or null), `publication_ids` (UUID strings), `run_profile:{model_profile:{profile_id,profile_version},publication_profile:{profile_id,profile_version},observation_profile:{profile_id,profile_version}}`, `scenario_digest` (frozen SHA), `batch_ids` (external Batch V2 IDs), `receipts` (one `{batch_id,accepted,duplicate,rejected,conflict}` per linked batch), `accepted_record_ids` (UUID strings for `ACCEPTED` dispositions only), and `public_digest`. Order publications by `(evidence_publication.recorded_at,evidence_publication.id)` and linked batches by that order; an unlinked publication is a valid pending release and contributes its ID but no batch/receipt/accepted IDs; a linked batch that is `IN_PROGRESS` or has incomplete dispositions is a 503 `COLD_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE`, never a partial completed receipt. Use `batch_publication_link` on all scoped IDs and `ingestion_batch`, then `ingestion_disposition` by `(batch_id,ordinal)`; recompute all four counts from dispositions, never `ingestion_batch` cached totals. `accepted_record_ids` includes the first accepted ID at its accepted ordinal and excludes duplicate references; `CONFLICT` is counted separately from `REJECTED`. For each disposition, parse the canonical `ingestion_batch.batch_text` Batch V2 and take the envelope at its ordinal, SHA-256 its canonical UTF-8 text, then append the JSON array `[external_batch_id,ordinal,envelope_sha256,decision,accepted_evidence_id_or_null]` to the ordered digest input. `public_digest=SHA-256(UTF8(canonical_json(that array)))`. A rejected/conflict row uses null for this final element; a duplicate uses its referenced accepted ID. Refuse missing ordinals, invalid canonical batch text, mismatched batch commitment or scope as 503. This digest commits to public envelopes and dispositions only; no private trajectory, forcing, report payload or run truth appears in the API.

**Six manifest files.** `contract-fixtures/w2/cold/{normal,excursion,backup-failed,missing-probe,late-reading,contradictory}.json` use canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, final newline) and exactly the keys named in the test paragraph above. `model_profile`, `publication_profile`, `observation_profile` are `{profile_id,profile_version}`; `window` is `{start:"2026-10-06T19:00:00Z",end:"2026-10-06T20:05:00Z",end_exclusive:true}`; `envelope_sha256` is the ordered array of canonical envelope digests, `batch_sha256` the ordered array of canonical Batch V2 payload digests, `receipt_dispositions` the ordered array of `{batch_id,ordinal,decision,accepted_evidence_id}` and `accepted_evidence_ids` the ordered accepted-only ID array. `assertions` is a closed object with `chamber_point_count`, `event_kinds` (ordered public kinds), `unavailable_count`, `late_source_time`, `late_published_at`, `start_result_at`, `transfer_result_at`, `high_1915`, `high_1920`; inapplicable fields are null. `schema="cold-replay-manifest/1"`, `site_code="COLD-LAB-001"`, `seed=20417`, and the six scenario IDs/digests and frozen revision IDs come from the registered fixture. `late-reading` has 12 chamber points before 20:10 release and 13 after; its manifest captures the completed post-release replay, while the test asserts both phases. All other cases have 13 except `missing-probe` with 7. A manifest is generated once from a fully executed registered path, reviewed, then pinned; the test never rewrites it during assertion.

/**
 * The approved v69 panel title map (`D-2026-10-17-mockup-layout-spec`,
 * `.agent/architect-W1-fidelity.md`). It is exhaustive: every screen's expected
 * panel titles are exactly `frontend/docs/architecture/v69-rendered-panels.json`,

 * W2-01 cold rules (`D-2026-10-17-w2-techdesign-cold`, `.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md` D-I). Do not add
 * an entry to keep an extra app panel; move its content into its owning panel.
 *
 * A dynamic title is a function of the selected read, never of a mock fixture.
 */
import rendered from "../../docs/architecture/v69-rendered-panels.json";

export type DynamicTitle = (values: Record<string, string>) => string;

/** `screen:index` â†’ the approved replacement for the JSON title. */
export const APPROVED_TITLE_CHANGES: Readonly<Record<string, string | DynamicTitle>> = {
  "foundation:2": "Identity and operating obligations",
  "dispatch:2": (v) => `Selected block Â· ${need(v, "interval")}`,
  "readiness:2": (v) => `Gateway status Â· ${need(v, "gateway")}`,
  "finding-evidence:1": (v) => `Evidence bundle Â· ${need(v, "finding")}`,
  "sld:1": (v) => (v.topology ? `${need(v, "site")} Â· ${v.topology}` : need(v, "site")),
  // W2-01: selected gateway or "No gateway selected"; Site name, plus the topology type only when declared.
  "cold-readiness:2": (v) => `Gateway status Â· ${need(v, "gateway")}`,
  "cold-sld:1": (v) => (v.topology ? `${need(v, "site")} Â· ${v.topology}` : need(v, "site")),
  // W1-F2 coordinator ruling (2026-10-17, under D-2026-10-16-w1-ux): the plain variant of "How a claim limit is set".
  "evidence-analysis:2": "How each limit is set",
  // W1-F5a, PROPOSED on the same basis as evidence-analysis:2 and pending the coordinator's ruling: "claim" is on
  // the W1 vocabulary list (D-2026-10-16-w1-ux), so the plain variant of "Condition evidence and claim boundary".
  // W2-03 q3 (D-2026-10-18-w2-03-answers, deviation 18): the plain variant of "Claim boundary" on the cold temperature screen.
  "temperature:3": "How each limit is set",
  "asset:3": "Condition evidence and its limits",
};

function need(values: Record<string, string>, key: string): string {
  const value = values[key];
  if (value === undefined || value === "") {
    throw new Error(`The dynamic panel title needs the selected read's "${key}" value.`);
  }
  return value;
}

const PANELS = (rendered as { panels: Record<string, { index: number; title: string }[]> }).panels;

/** The expected panel titles of one v69 screen, in order. */
export function expectedPanelTitles(screenId: string, values: Record<string, string> = {}): string[] {
  const entry = PANELS[screenId];
  if (entry === undefined) throw new Error(`No v69 rendered-panel entry for screen "${screenId}".`);
  return [...entry]
    .sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index)
    .map(({ index, title }) => {
      const change = APPROVED_TITLE_CHANGES[`${screenId}:${index}`];
      if (change === undefined) return title;
      return typeof change === "string" ? change : change(values);
    });
}

#: The directed component-type pairs each medium may join in a COLDCHAIN topology (design section 3 A):

#: meter -> transfer switch -> AC bus -> compressor plus generator -> transfer switch (AC).
COLD_EDGE_TYPES: dict[str, frozenset[tuple[str, str]]] = {

        ("TRANSFER_SWITCH", "AC_BUS"),

        ("GENERATOR", "TRANSFER_SWITCH"),
    }),
}

# --- Foundation validation (refuses, before anything is written) ----------------------------------------------


def validate_cold_foundation(foundation: SiteFoundation, *, source: str,
                             invalid: Callable[[str], NoReturn]) -> None:
    """Refuse a COLDCHAIN Foundation that breaks a section 3 rule. Runs after the shared strict parser."""
    types = {c.component_id: c.component_type for c in foundation.components}
    for component in foundation.components:
        values: dict[str, float] = {}
        for prop in component.properties or ():
            carrier = COLD_PROPERTY_CARRIERS.get(prop.property_key)
            if carrier is None:
                continue
            if component.component_type != carrier:
                invalid(f"{prop.property_key} belongs on a {carrier} component, not on {component.component_id} "
                        f"({component.component_type}), in {source}.")
            values[prop.property_key] = prop.value
        for key in _STRICTLY_POSITIVE:
            if key in values and not values[key] > 0:
                invalid(f"{key} on {component.component_id} must be greater than zero in {source}.")

"""The code-owned MINIGRID signal role vocabulary (S1-02).

Decided by `D-2026-10-08-s1-bindings-roles-and-snapshot` (Architect answers
Q1, Q3 and Q4 in `.agent/architect-S1-02-answers-2026-10-08.md`). Every
vocabulary choice lives here; the binding mechanism does not name a role.

A role names what a bound channel means for analysis. The canonical unit is
fixed per role. A role is either a channel role (bound to one registered
device signal) or a configuration role (covered by a Foundation control, not
by a channel).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

#: S1-02's vocabulary. Kept readable for every binding set recorded under it.
ROLE_SET_MINIGRID_1 = "minigrid-roles-1"
#: S3-01 (`D-2026-10-11-s3-dispatch-interval-assessment`, Architect batch 5
#: "S3-01 Planner questions"): roles-1 plus the two optional capability
#: channels a dispatch Candidate needs. Observed `pv_power` and
#: `battery_power` are not these capabilities.
ROLE_SET_MINIGRID_2 = "minigrid-roles-2"
#: S6-02a (`D-2026-10-16-s6-verification`, `D-2026-10-16-s602-questions`):
#: roles-2 plus the requested and delivered critical-load power a reserve
#: trial's service guardrail needs. A Site opts in by publishing with this
#: role set explicitly; new publications still default to roles-2.
ROLE_SET_MINIGRID_3 = "minigrid-roles-3"
#: The set a new MINIGRID binding publication is recorded under.
ROLE_SET_MINIGRID = ROLE_SET_MINIGRID_2
#: W2-01 (`.agent/W2-technical-design-cold.md` section 3, `D-2026-10-17-w2-01-answers`
#: and its W2-02 channel closure): the immutable COLDCHAIN vocabulary.
ROLE_SET_COLD_1 = "cold-roles-1"

#: The canonical generator states an ENUM conversion may map to.
GENERATOR_STATES: tuple[str, ...] = ("STOPPED", "STARTING", "RUNNING", "FAILED")
#: W2-01 role-specific ENUM member sets (`D-2026-10-17-w2-01-answers` B).
COMPRESSOR_STATES: tuple[str, ...] = ("OFF", "STARTING", "RUNNING", "FAILED")
GRID_STATES: tuple[str, ...] = ("AVAILABLE", "LOST")
BUS_STATES: tuple[str, ...] = ("POWERED", "UNPOWERED")

#: The nonquantitative declared unit of an event channel (`SIGNAL_UNITS`).
EVENT_UNIT = "event"

#: One binding per Site, or one per asset of the role's asset type.
ONE = "ONE"
PER_ASSET = "PER_ASSET"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Role:
    role: str
    label: str
    asset_type: str
    canonical_unit: str
    value_kind: str  # NUMBER | STATE | EVENT
    cardinality: str  # ONE | PER_ASSET
    required: bool
    #: "CHANNEL" roles are bound to a device signal; "FOUNDATION_CONTROL"
    #: roles are covered by a configured Foundation control (decision Q3).
    covered_by: str = "CHANNEL"
    #: S6-02a: a ONE role describing the Site's critical load - the first
    #: member of the Foundation's `critical-load-priority` control. The
    #: control identifies the one asset, so several LOAD components are not
    #: an ambiguity; a binding naming any other load is refused.
#: Property units whose values are signed: a temperature below zero is a
#: temperature, not a direction (`D-2026-10-17-w2-01-answers` C). Every other
#: property unit stays a nonnegative magnitude.
SIGNED_PROPERTY_UNITS = frozenset({"degC"})

#: Every unit a declared property may carry, derived from the vocabulary so a
#: property added above cannot introduce a unit nothing knows about and a unit
#: listed here cannot outlive the property that used it.
PROPERTY_UNITS = frozenset(
    definition.unit for definition in COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS.values()
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ComponentProperty:
    """One typed physical or control property a Foundation declares.

    `property_key` is a member of `COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS` and carries
    that definition's unit; `kind` is read from the definition rather than
    authored, because a document choosing whether its own value is physical or
    control would be a second answer to a question the vocabulary settles.

    `source` and `source_version` are provenance about this property: which
    document declared it and at which version. A property copied from a
    template keeps `TEMPLATE` and the template version it was copied at, so a
    later template change stays visible as drift rather than reaching back
    into the Site.

    Declared truth, never evidence. That a Foundation declares 0.31 L/kWh is
    not a claim that any generator has burned anything.
    """

    property_key: str
    value: float
    unit: str
    kind: str
    source: str
    source_version: int


# --- Foundation content below the component list ----------------------------
#
# T014 adds topology, devices, signal availability, device-to-signal mappings,
# and control assumptions to what a Foundation may declare. Everything here is
# shared between a template's Foundation and a Site's Foundation, in the same
# way `Rating` already is: these are leaf value types, and a Site's copy is
# free to diverge in its VALUES without either Foundation growing a mode.
#
# Two vocabularies this slice deliberately does NOT settle, because the T016
# user-review checkpoint owns them:
#
#   - whether a breaker is a device, component state, or both, and what the
#     control state vocabulary is. `ControlAssumption` below therefore carries
#     a declared statement and its basis, not a control model.
#   - how cold-room process symbols relate to mini-grid electrical topology.
#     `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` carries only the electrical positions the shipped
#     hybrid mini-grid template needs to parse.

# Where a component sits in the site's electrical topology. Closed, because a
# later SLD archetype binds against these and an unrecognised role would be a
# node nothing could draw.
#
# This is topology position, not component identity: `component_type` remains
# the canonical vocabulary for what a component IS, and no component carries a
# second role axis.
#
# `GENERATION` rather than `SOURCE` deliberately. `source` already means where
# a Site's evidence comes from, and a topology role sharing that word would put
# two unrelated meanings of it on one screen.
TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES = frozenset(
    {
        "GENERATION",
        "CONVERSION",
        "STORAGE",
        "BUS",
        "METERING",
        "LOAD",
        "FUEL_STORAGE",
        # W2-01 (`D-2026-10-17-w2-01-answers` A): cold room, temperature
        # probe, compressor and transfer switch positions.
        "COLD_ROOM",
        "SENSOR",
        "COOLING",
        "SWITCH",
    }
)

# What flows along a connection. Closed for the same reason: a connection whose
# medium is not understood cannot be drawn or simulated, so it is a
# configuration error rather than a passthrough string.
#
# W2-01 adds `SIGNAL` (room -> primary chamber probe) and `THERMAL`
# (compressor -> room); the cold validator checks each medium's endpoints.
CONNECTION_MEDIA = frozenset({"AC", "DC", "FUEL", "SIGNAL", "THERMAL"})

# What kind of thing a declared device is. Deliberately small: only what the
# shipped hybrid mini-grid template needs. A device here is a configured asset,
# never an operating one - nothing in this record says a device exists, has
# been commissioned, or has ever reported.
DEVICE_TYPES = frozenset({"METER", "SENSOR", "CONTROLLER"})

# Units a declared signal may carry. Closed, and separate from `RATING_UNITS`:
# a nameplate rating and a reportable signal are different kinds of fact, and
# collapsing their vocabularies would let a rating unit onto a signal.
#
# T025b adds `state`: a signal whose reading is a typed discrete member (a
# generator's `RUNNING`), never a number. It is the unit the execution contract
# already types discrete values by (`assetops_contracts.control.DISCRETE_UNIT`).
#
# W2-01 adds `event`: the nonquantitative declared unit of an event channel,
# never a numeric evidence unit (`D-2026-10-17-w2-01-answers` B).
SIGNAL_UNITS = frozenset(
    {"kW", "kWh", "V", "Hz", "L", "degC", "W/m2", "%", "state", "event"}
)

+## Causal pack and public transform

Per UTC minute apply forcing sorted `(time,connector,kind)`, with PLUG before FAULT at equal time. Plug assigns the deterministic scoped session ID; authorization lasts one minute; accepted charging emits START. Denial emits no START. Active fault emits FAULT+ABORT; pre-START fault emits FAULT only. Explicit unplug after active charge and without fault emits END. Grid loss pauses power; it never fabricates ABORT. Clear requires forcing. Available shared kW is `max(0,80-base_load)`, allocated in 1 kW round-robin quanta by connector ID with persistent pointer, bounded by request, connector and charger ratings; exact decimal `energy_next=energy+allocated_kw/60`. Private vehicle request/forcing/oracle remains in world data only.

At each boundary round cumulative kWh half-even to 0.001, subtract rounded boundaries, preserve additive total. `source_time=interval_end` for intervals. Every connector record carries nonnull `session_id,connector_id`; Site meter uses explicit null session/connector. `connector_id` equals the bound asset ID; no charger serial or customer ID becomes a session ID. W2-00 `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT`, `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH`, `EV_DELTA_*` rules are unchanged. IDs are `ev-` plus lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON array `[scenario_sha256,device_id,signal_id,transition_ordinal]`; correlations use `ev-` plus SHA-256 of `[scenario_sha256,"session",session_id]`. They satisfy v4 `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`; only `report_key` may use `ev:` prefix, following cold's separate report-key grammar. Retransmission preserves bytes. `ev-observation/1` drops/holds/replaces public reports only; late END keeps source time/ID and publishes at 09:05. A fault latches FAULTED, emits FAULT and ABORT for an active started session; explicit user unplug emits END (completed) only after active charge and no fault; grid interruption pauses allocation and connector state, it does not invent ABORT. +- [x] Identifier and wire formats: UUID Site/asset/revision IDs, UTC effective selections, v4 session/connector identity, half-open schedule intervals and exact EV roles below.

+## Code seams and exact Foundation
+
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Follow `cold_foundation.py:validate_cold_foundation` with a pure `sites/ev_foundation.py:validate_ev_foundation` and selected projection, not a second persistence path. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. Refuse duplicate directed edges, cycles, orphan connector, more than one parent charger, charger without one feed/meter, and cross-Site links. No stationary battery is implied.
+
+Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite; connector-enabled is the typed `ENABLED|DISABLED` state (not a numeric flag). The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Downgrade refuses with EV measurements, then drops the index while retaining historical Foundation reader safety. No new configuration SQL table.
+
+Represent the connector enable schedule as a typed, time-valid Foundation control, keyed by connector asset and Site timezone, weekly local half-open intervals plus explicit UTC offset resolution for DST. The fixture declares both connectors enabled Monday 08:00–16:00 UTC for 2026-10-06. Reject overlap, reversed/zero interval, ambiguous/nonexistent local instant, disabled connector marked available, and enablement without feed/meter/charger. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.
+
+## Role set, binding and selected read
+
+Extend `sites/binding_roles.py:Role,ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE,roles_for` with immutable `ev-roles-1`. `ev_session_event` and optional `ev_connector_fault` are EVENT/`event`/IDENTITY per EV_CONNECTOR, one channel each; event kinds and outcomes are the W2-00 v4 allowlist. `ev_connector_state` is STATE/`state`/ENUM per connector, max 60-second cadence with `AVAILABLE|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED|DISABLED`. `ev_connector_energy` is `INTERVAL_DELTA`/kWh/IDENTITY_KWH per connector, aligned 300-second half-open slots; `ev_connector_power` is optional `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW. `ev_site_import` is `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW ONE per feed and is required only for site-power comparison, not outcome/energy. `ev_requested_power` and `ev_allocated_limit` are optional independent `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW controller channels. Outcome requires session events; fault association requires fault event; supported energy requires energy meter; service-state context requires status. Use `binding_service.py:validate_bindings,publish,acquisition_snapshot` and `binding_alignment.py` to bind exact registered source/device/signal, asset, unit, conversion, clock/cadence and effective interval. Add only the EV tuples to the closed `evidence/gateway_access.py:V4_CHANNEL_MAPPINGS` table; the gateway supplies the five snapshot metadata keys at a new published revision, following W2-02, not on a historical conversion. Do not let one physical signal silently satisfy incompatible roles. Keep v3 bytes and cold binding snapshots unchanged.
+
+`sites/ev_foundation.py` returns `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` and only the design's eight codes: `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`, `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND`, `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED`, `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. The first six indicate configuration/capability; the last two are separate contact and commissioning notices. The registered Lab Draft gate in `binding_service.py:acquisition_snapshot` must use the selected EV rule rather than mini-grid electrical gaps: block absent connector/feed/limit or required session/status/energy bindings; optional site import/fault/power roles do not block a run that does not claim their capability. A wrong role set or failed effective binding refuses Draft. No test-only gap lift.
+
+Add selected `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/ev/foundation?at=<UTC>` beside the existing cold Foundation router/composition (`rg 'build_cold_foundation_router' backend/assetops_backend`). Response: `site_id,site_code,site_type,selected_at,foundation_revision_id,binding_revision_id,feed:{asset_id,limit_kw,meter_asset_id},chargers:[{asset_id,max_kw,connectors:[{asset_id,max_kw,enabled_schedule,meter_resolution_kwh,meter_error_bound_kwh}]}],topology:{nodes,edges},bindings:[{role,asset_id,source_id,device_id,signal_id,unit,cadence_seconds,effective_from,effective_to}],readiness:{state,messages},contact:{state,as_of,gateway_id,reason},commissioning:{state,evidence_ids}`. JSON decimal quantities are decimal strings; unknowns are null, not zero. Use the cold selected-read `Access`/source gate: 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN`, 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND` including wrong type after access check, 422 `EV_SELECTION_INVALID`, 503 `EV_FOUNDATION_UNAVAILABLE`; malformed/extra query fields refuse. `contact` maps S7 CURRENT→RECENT, STALE→STALE, absent diagnostic→NEVER with reason and null `as_of`; selected gateway identity comes from registration, not mock GW-EV-01. Per-source contact is unavailable in 05a. `commissioning` is always `UNCONFIRMED`, `evidence_ids=[]` until a real record exists; do not manufacture it from a good gateway receipt. Contact recency is measured by the S7 read at the selected reference, and the UI states that it is source contact, not charger health.
+

+## Code seams and exact Foundation
+
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. Refuse duplicate directed edges, cycles, orphan connector, more than one parent charger, charger without one feed/meter, and cross-Site links. No stationary battery is implied.

+Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite; connector-enabled is the typed `ENABLED|DISABLED` state (not a numeric flag). The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Downgrade refuses with EV measurements, then drops the index while retaining historical Foundation reader safety. No new configuration SQL table.
+
+Represent the connector enable schedule as a typed, time-valid Foundation control, keyed by connector asset and Site timezone, weekly local half-open intervals plus explicit UTC offset resolution for DST. The fixture declares both connectors enabled Monday 08:00–16:00 UTC for 2026-10-06. Reject overlap, reversed/zero interval, ambiguous/nonexistent local instant, disabled connector marked available, and enablement without feed/meter/charger. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.

+## Role set, binding and selected read
+
+Extend `sites/binding_roles.py:Role,ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE,roles_for` with immutable `ev-roles-1`. `ev_session_event` and optional `ev_connector_fault` are EVENT/`event`/IDENTITY per EV_CONNECTOR, one channel each; event kinds and outcomes are the W2-00 v4 allowlist. `ev_connector_state` is STATE/`state`/ENUM per connector, max 60-second cadence with `AVAILABLE|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED|DISABLED`. `ev_connector_energy` is `INTERVAL_DELTA`/kWh/IDENTITY_KWH per connector, aligned 300-second half-open slots; `ev_connector_power` is optional `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW. `ev_site_import` is `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW ONE per feed and is required only for site-power comparison, not outcome/energy. `ev_requested_power` and `ev_allocated_limit` are optional independent `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW controller channels. Outcome requires session events; fault association requires fault event; supported energy requires energy meter; service-state context requires status. Use `binding_service.py:validate_bindings,publish,acquisition_snapshot` and `binding_alignment.py` to bind exact registered source/device/signal, asset, unit, conversion, clock/cadence and effective interval. +
+`sites/ev_foundation.py` returns `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` and only the design's eight codes: `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`, `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND`, `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED`, `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. The first six indicate configuration/capability; the last two are separate contact and commissioning notices. The registered Lab Draft gate in `binding_service.py:acquisition_snapshot` must use the selected EV rule rather than mini-grid electrical gaps: block absent connector/feed/limit or required session/status/energy bindings; optional site import/fault/power roles do not block a run that does not claim their capability. A wrong role set or failed effective binding refuses Draft. No test-only gap lift.

+Add selected `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/ev/foundation?at=<UTC>` beside the existing cold Foundation router/composition (`rg 'build_cold_foundation_router' backend/assetops_backend`). # Priority lists name explicit component identities. The parser requires each
# list to name EVERY component of its member types exactly once, so there is
# no implicit tie order and no display-name matching.


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SiteControlDefinition:
    """One member of the closed Site Control vocabulary."""

    display_name: str
    member_types: frozenset[str]
    statement: str


SITE_CONTROL_DEFINITIONS: dict[str, SiteControlDefinition] = {
    "source-priority": SiteControlDefinition(
        display_name="Source priority",
        member_types=frozenset({"PV_ARRAY", "BATTERY", "GENERATOR"}),
        statement=(
            "The order in which the site's sources serve load, first to last. "
            "Names every PV array, battery and generator the Foundation "
            "declares, each once."
        ),
    ),
    "critical-load-priority": SiteControlDefinition(
        display_name="Critical-load priority",
        member_types=frozenset({"LOAD"}),
        statement=(
            "The order in which loads are protected when supply cannot serve "
            "all of them, first to last. Names every load the Foundation "
            "declares, each once."
        ),
    ),
}

#: Where a Site Control came from; the same two values as a property's source.
SITE_CONTROL_SOURCES = frozenset({"TEMPLATE", "SITE"})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SiteControl:
    """One typed Site Control: an ordered list of component identities."""

    control_key: str
    members: tuple[str, ...]
    source: str
    source_version: int


# Where a declared control assumption comes from. Provenance about the
# assumption, not a control vocabulary: `TEMPLATE` is an assumption the
# archetype declared and the site copied, `SITE` is one declared for this site.
CONTROL_ASSUMPTION_BASES = frozenset({"TEMPLATE", "SITE"})


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Rating:
    """A declared design rating for a template component.

    This is nameplate intent from the shipped document, never a measurement.
    """

    value: float
    unit: str

#
# Validated here, once, for both document families, for the reason the whole
# module exists: a template declaring a property the Site store would refuse
# is a template that seeds an unreadable Site. The component parsers in
# `parsing.py` and `site_parsing.py` each call this one function.


def parse_component_properties(
    raw: Any, *, where: str, source: str, invalid: Invalid
) -> tuple[ComponentProperty, ...] | None:
    """Validate the typed properties one component declares.

    `None` is the document declaring none, and it is the compatibility path a
    Site written before T020A takes: the key is absent, nothing is invented,
    and the Site stays readable exactly as it was. An empty list is refused
    for the reason every other empty collection in this module is - a table
    with a header and no rows states that this component HAS no properties,
    which is a claim about the world a configuration document may not make.

    The unit is checked against the vocabulary rather than against a set of
    spellings. `specific-fuel-consumption` is `L/kWh` and nothing else, so a
    document declaring it in `L/h` is refused here rather than storing a
    number that is true only at one operating point.
    """
    if raw is None:
        return None

    entries = _require_non_empty_list(
        raw,
        where=where,
        source=source,
        limit=MAX_COMPONENT_PROPERTIES,
        invalid=invalid,
    )
    properties = tuple(
        _parse_component_property(
            entry, where=f"{where}[{index}]", source=source, invalid=invalid
        )
        for index, entry in enumerate(entries)
    )
    _reject_duplicates(
        [item.property_key for item in properties],
        kind="property_key",
        where=where,
        source=source,
        invalid=invalid,
    )

+Decision `D-2026-10-18-w2-05-buildspec`. Implements `tasks/W2-05a-ev-foundation.md` on current main after merged W2-00..03. Authority: amended `.agent/W2-technical-design-ev.md`, `D-2026-10-18-w2-mockup-authority`, `D-2026-10-17-mockup-layout-spec`. EV mock content and layout are binding. The cited symbols, rather than older design line numbers, are current code anchors.
+
+## Readiness gate (checked 2026-10-18)
+
+- [x] Identifier and wire formats: UUID Site/asset/revision IDs, UTC effective selections, v4 session/connector identity, half-open schedule intervals and exact EV roles below.
+- [x] Fixture and publication: EV-LAB-001 complete and missing-role Foundation values, immutable registered binding revision and Site-scoped gateway/source mapping below.
+- [x] Every integration seam: shared parser/store, cold validator/read pattern, role registry, snapshot gate, API composition and three Site routes named below.
+- [x] Guards: Foundation store sole writer, rule-8 ownership, existing SQL driver/import allowlists and UI/domain dependency direction below.
+- [x] Refusals, cutoff and freshness: selected effective `at`, configuration/contact/commissioning separation, scoped errors and no wall-clock equipment inference below.
+- [x] UI: exact eight v69 panels, dynamic titles, empty/refused/unavailable copy and 1440/390 proof below.
+- [x] Lab/run artifacts: 05a adds no run or execution artifact; its effective Foundation/binding IDs and values are the frozen inputs consumed by 05b.
+
+## Code seams and exact Foundation
+
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Follow `cold_foundation.py:validate_cold_foundation` with a pure `sites/ev_foundation.py:validate_ev_foundation` and selected projection, not a second persistence path. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. Refuse duplicate directed edges, cycles, orphan connector, more than one parent charger, charger without one feed/meter, and cross-Site links. No stationary battery is implied.
+
+Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite; connector-enabled is the typed `ENABLED|DISABLED` state (not a numeric flag). The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Downgrade refuses with EV measurements, then drops the index while retaining historical Foundation reader safety. No new configuration SQL table.
+
+Represent the connector enable schedule as a typed, time-valid Foundation control, keyed by connector asset and Site timezone, weekly local half-open intervals plus explicit UTC offset resolution for DST. The fixture declares both connectors enabled Monday 08:00–16:00 UTC for 2026-10-06. Reject overlap, reversed/zero interval, ambiguous/nonexistent local instant, disabled connector marked available, and enablement without feed/meter/charger. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.
+
+## Role set, binding and selected read
+
+Extend `sites/binding_roles.py:Role,ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE,roles_for` with immutable `ev-roles-1`. `ev_session_event` and optional `ev_connector_fault` are EVENT/`event`/IDENTITY per EV_CONNECTOR, one channel each; event kinds and outcomes are the W2-00 v4 allowlist. `ev_connector_state` is STATE/`state`/ENUM per connector, max 60-second cadence with `AVAILABLE|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED|DISABLED`. `ev_connector_energy` is `INTERVAL_DELTA`/kWh/IDENTITY_KWH per connector, aligned 300-second half-open slots; `ev_connector_power` is optional `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW. `ev_site_import` is `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW ONE per feed and is required only for site-power comparison, not outcome/energy. `ev_requested_power` and `ev_allocated_limit` are optional independent `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW controller channels. Outcome requires session events; fault association requires fault event; supported energy requires energy meter; service-state context requires status. Use `binding_service.py:validate_bindings,publish,acquisition_snapshot` and `binding_alignment.py` to bind exact registered source/device/signal, asset, unit, conversion, clock/cadence and effective interval. Add only the EV tuples to the closed `evidence/gateway_access.py:V4_CHANNEL_MAPPINGS` table; the gateway supplies the five snapshot metadata keys at a new published revision, following W2-02, not on a historical conversion. Do not let one physical signal silently satisfy incompatible roles. Keep v3 bytes and cold binding snapshots unchanged.
+
+`sites/ev_foundation.py` returns `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` and only the design's eight codes: `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`, `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND`, `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED`, `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. The first six indicate configuration/capability; the last two are separate contact and commissioning notices. The registered Lab Draft gate in `binding_service.py:acquisition_snapshot` must use the selected EV rule rather than mini-grid electrical gaps: block absent connector/feed/limit or required session/status/energy bindings; optional site import/fault/power roles do not block a run that does not claim their capability. A wrong role set or failed effective binding refuses Draft. No test-only gap lift.
+
+Add selected `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/ev/foundation?at=<UTC>` beside the existing cold Foundation router/composition (`rg 'build_cold_foundation_router' backend/assetops_backend`). Response: `site_id,site_code,site_type,selected_at,foundation_revision_id,binding_revision_id,feed:{asset_id,limit_kw,meter_asset_id},chargers:[{asset_id,max_kw,connectors:[{asset_id,max_kw,enabled_schedule,meter_resolution_kwh,meter_error_bound_kwh}]}],topology:{nodes,edges},bindings:[{role,asset_id,source_id,device_id,signal_id,unit,cadence_seconds,effective_from,effective_to}],readiness:{state,messages},contact:{state,as_of,gateway_id,reason},commissioning:{state,evidence_ids}`. JSON decimal quantities are decimal strings; unknowns are null, not zero. Use the cold selected-read `Access`/source gate: 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN`, 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND` including wrong type after access check, 422 `EV_SELECTION_INVALID`, 503 `EV_FOUNDATION_UNAVAILABLE`; malformed/extra query fields refuse. `contact` maps S7 CURRENT→RECENT, STALE→STALE, absent diagnostic→NEVER with reason and null `as_of`; selected gateway identity comes from registration, not mock GW-EV-01. Per-source contact is unavailable in 05a. `commissioning` is always `UNCONFIRMED`, `evidence_ids=[]` until a real record exists; do not manufacture it from a good gateway receipt. Contact recency is measured by the S7 read at the selected reference, and the UI states that it is source contact, not charger health.
+
+## Three routes and fidelity proof
+
+Use `frontend/src/shell/SiteFoundationFrame.tsx` Site-type switch, `frontend/src/sites/ColdFoundationViews.tsx` as the shared three-route/panel pattern, `frontend/src/test/panelStructure.ts:expectV69Panels` and `frontend/src/test/v69PanelTitles.ts:APPROVED_TITLE_CHANGES`. Add `ev-readiness:2` dynamic `Gateway status · {selected gateway or No gateway selected}` and `ev-sld:1` dynamic `{selected Site} · {declared topology type}` (Site only when type absent). Use the existing Foundation/readiness/SLD URLs; no new route hierarchy. Panel source is `frontend/docs/architecture/v69-rendered-panels.json`: `ev-foundation` (1 Physical site, 2 Operating interpretation); `ev-readiness` (1 Readiness and commissioning evidence, 2 Gateway status, 3 Connected sources, 4 Effect on readiness and confidence); `ev-sld` (1 selected Site/type, 2 What each part does). Put feed/chargers/connectors/limits/bindings into their exact mock slots. No extra leading answer card, live flow, inferred battery, health badge or mock fixture number.
+
+Copy in gaps: undeclared connector `No connector declared`; missing limit `Site import limit not declared`; readiness `Needs a source` with the missing role in plain words; no diagnostic `No gateway contact recorded`; no per-source read `Source contact unavailable`; commissioning `Commissioning unconfirmed`; no capability assessment `Not assessed`; no function description `Function not recorded`; no live flow `Live power flow is not observed here`. A valid empty selection keeps every panel with `No EV Foundation for this selection`; 403 keeps skeleton and says `Source details are not available for this Site` without IDs; 503 says `EV Foundation is temporarily unavailable` with retry and must not look like successful empty data. Plain labels follow W1/W2-03 vocabulary; exact IDs remain in contextual detail. Preserve mock in-page unavailable entries as accessible, noninteractive `Not available yet`, extending the declared guard only for entries actually present on these three mock screens.
+
+In `frontend/src/sites/__tests__/evFoundation.test.tsx`, call `expectV69Panels` on each route for stocked, missing-role and 403/503 states, asserting indexed title count/order, grid/prominence and in-panel gaps. Capture each app/mock route at 1440 and 390 with Site, revision, mock hash, URL and images. Apply `.agent/architect-W1-fidelity.md` recurring defects and ~1.3× panel-height rule; structural drift is High. Run focused backend/frontend/typecheck/build, `tools/writer_guard_probes.py`, `tools/check-all.ps1` and registry checker; one full backend suite on final revision. No EV SQL writer outside the existing Foundation/binding store, no SQL driver in pure EV projection/API/UI, no accepted-evidence insert in 05a.

+## Causal pack and public transform
+
+Register `ev-charger/1` in the closed dispatch used by `host/execution_adapter.py`, `host/lab_execution.py` and simulator kernel, beside `cold-thermal/1`; never use fallback to fuel/mini-grid on unknown identity. Add pure pack under `simulator/assetops_simulator/packs/ev_charger.py` using the neutral `packs/errors.py:PhysicallyUnacceptable`. Start `UNPLUGGED`, no session/fault, 0 kWh. Per UTC minute apply forcing sorted `(time,connector,kind)`, with PLUG before FAULT at equal time. Plug assigns the deterministic scoped session ID; authorization lasts one minute; accepted charging emits START. Denial emits no START. Active fault emits FAULT+ABORT; pre-START fault emits FAULT only. Explicit unplug after active charge and without fault emits END. Grid loss pauses power; it never fabricates ABORT. Clear requires forcing. Available shared kW is `max(0,80-base_load)`, allocated in 1 kW round-robin quanta by connector ID with persistent pointer, bounded by request, connector and charger ratings; exact decimal `energy_next=energy+allocated_kw/60`. Guard every state transition, monotone time, finite nonnegative energy, allocation sum/limits, residual, and one START/terminal per ID. Private vehicle request/forcing/oracle remains in world data only.
+
+`ev-publication/1` in the simulator observation/publish seam produces state on transition and each minute; connector `INTERVAL_DELTA` kWh and optional power/site import means on aligned five-minute half-open slots; session/fault events at transitions. Split boundary slots into nonoverlapping subintervals. At each boundary round cumulative kWh half-even to 0.001, subtract rounded boundaries, preserve additive total. `source_time=interval_end` for intervals. Every connector record carries nonnull `session_id,connector_id`; Site meter uses explicit null session/connector. `connector_id` equals the bound asset ID; no charger serial or customer ID becomes a session ID. W2-00 `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT`, `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH`, `EV_DELTA_*` rules are unchanged. IDs are `ev-` plus lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON array `[scenario_sha256,device_id,signal_id,transition_ordinal]`; correlations use `ev-` plus SHA-256 of `[scenario_sha256,"session",session_id]`. They satisfy v4 `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`; only `report_key` may use `ev:` prefix, following cold's separate report-key grammar. Retransmission preserves bytes. `ev-observation/1` drops/holds/replaces public reports only; late END keeps source time/ID and publishes at 09:05. The contradictory case adds a distinct public GOOD END at 08:30 while the model emits only its genuine END at 08:31. No direct accepted-row/Finding seed.

+Reuse `contracts/assetops_contracts/gateway_report.py:DeviceReportV2`; gateway `GatewayService._admit_in` remains sole v4 envelope/sequence/message allocator. Add the EV tuple matrix `(charger-controller,session-event)`, `(connector-controller,fault-event|state|requested-power|allocated-limit)`, `(connector-meter,energy|power)`, `(site-meter,import)` with exact family/kind/unit/role from design §3. Its value is the exact string `ENABLED|DISABLED`, unit `state`, kind CONTROL; all preexisting numeric properties keep identical parser/rendered bytes. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. Outcome requires session events; fault association requires fault event; supported energy requires energy meter; service-state context requires status. Per UTC minute apply forcing sorted `(time,connector,kind)`, with PLUG before FAULT at equal time. Plug assigns the deterministic scoped session ID; authorization lasts one minute; accepted charging emits START. Denial emits no START. Active fault emits FAULT+ABORT; pre-START fault emits FAULT only. Explicit unplug after active charge and without fault emits END. Grid loss pauses power; it never fabricates ABORT. Clear requires forcing. Available shared kW is `max(0,80-base_load)`, allocated in 1 kW round-robin quanta by connector ID with persistent pointer, bounded by request, connector and charger ratings; exact decimal `energy_next=energy+allocated_kw/60`. Guard every state transition, monotone time, finite nonnegative energy, allocation sum/limits, residual, and one START/terminal per ID. Private vehicle request/forcing/oracle remains in world data only.
+
+`ev-publication/1` in the simulator observation/publish seam produces state on transition and each minute; connector `INTERVAL_DELTA` kWh and optional power/site import means on aligned five-minute half-open slots; session/fault events at transitions. Split boundary slots into nonoverlapping subintervals. At each boundary round cumulative kWh half-even to 0.001, subtract rounded boundaries, preserve additive total. `source_time=interval_end` for intervals. Every connector record carries nonnull `session_id,connector_id`; Site meter uses explicit null session/connector. `connector_id` equals the bound asset ID; no charger serial or customer ID becomes a session ID. W2-00 `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT`, `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH`, `EV_DELTA_*` rules are unchanged. IDs are `ev-` plus lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON array `[scenario_sha256,device_id,signal_id,transition_ordinal]`; correlations use `ev-` plus SHA-256 of `[scenario_sha256,"session",session_id]`. They satisfy v4 `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`; only `report_key` may use `ev:` prefix, following cold's separate report-key grammar. Retransmission preserves bytes. `ev-observation/1` drops/holds/replaces public reports only; late END keeps source time/ID and publishes at 09:05. The contradictory case adds a distinct public GOOD END at 08:30 while the model emits only its genuine END at 08:31. No direct accepted-row/Finding seed.

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ComponentProperty:
    """One typed physical or control property a Foundation declares.

    `property_key` is a member of `COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS` and carries
    that definition's unit; `kind` is read from the definition rather than
    authored, because a document choosing whether its own value is physical or
    control would be a second answer to a question the vocabulary settles.

    `source` and `source_version` are provenance about this property: which
    document declared it and at which version. A property copied from a
    template keeps `TEMPLATE` and the template version it was copied at, so a
    later template change stays visible as drift rather than reaching back
    into the Site.



def render_component_properties(
    properties: "tuple[ComponentProperty, ...] | None",
) -> "list[dict[str, Any]] | None":
    """Render typed properties back into the document shape.

    `kind` is not written, because it is not read: it is the vocabulary's
    answer, and a document carrying it would be a second place for it to be
    wrong.
    """
    if properties is None:
        return None

    return [
        {
            "property_key": item.property_key,
            "value": item.value,
            "unit": item.unit,
            "source": item.source,
            "source_version": item.source_version,
        }
        for item in properties
    ]


# --- Shared field rules -----------------------------------------------------

#: The V4 refusal kinds S2 records per ordinal (beyond the shared envelope kinds).
V4_REJECTION_KINDS = frozenset({
    "MAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE", "UNIT_INCOMPATIBLE", "RECORD_KIND_UNSUPPORTED", "CORRELATION_INVALID",
    "EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH", "EV_DELTA_UNIT_INVALID", "EV_DELTA_INTERVAL_INVALID", "EV_DELTA_VALUE_INVALID",
})

_ID_KEYS = frozenset({"event_id", "correlation_id", "session_id", "connector_id"})

#: Refusal kinds only the V4 parser raises. The shared `ENVELOPE_REJECTION_KINDS` vocabulary of the v1/v2/v3
#: readers stays unchanged; V4 refusals are a subclass, so every caller catching the shared type still does.
V4_PARSER_REJECTION_KINDS = frozenset({
    "RECORD_KIND_UNSUPPORTED", "CORRELATION_INVALID", "EV_DELTA_UNIT_INVALID", "EV_DELTA_INTERVAL_INVALID",
    "EV_DELTA_VALUE_INVALID",
})


class EnvelopeRejected(_SharedEnvelopeRejected):
    """A V4 refusal: the shared envelope kinds plus `V4_PARSER_REJECTION_KINDS`."""

    def __init__(self, kind: str, field: str, detail: str) -> None:
        if kind not in V4_PARSER_REJECTION_KINDS:
            super().__init__(kind, field, detail)
            return
        self.kind = kind
        self.field = field
        self.detail = detail
        ValueError.__init__(self, f"{kind} at {field}: {detail}")

def canonical_binding_metadata(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """A snapshot binding row's five v4 keys in canonical spelling, or None when any is absent or ill-typed."""
    if any(row.get(k) is None for k in V4_BINDING_METADATA_KEYS):

        return f"a {kind} conversion is not published in this release; only IDENTITY and ENUM are"
    if kind not in CONVERSION_KINDS:
        return f"conversion kind {kind!r} is not one of {', '.join(CONVERSION_KINDS)}"
    if not isinstance(parameters, dict):
        return "conversion parameters must be an object"
    if kind == "IDENTITY":
        if parameters:
            return "an IDENTITY conversion takes no parameters"
        if role.value_kind == "STATE":
            return f"{role.label} is a state; use an ENUM conversion"
        # W2-01: the `event` unit is valid only on an EVENT role, whose
        # IDENTITY passes its declared unit through and converts nothing.
        if source_unit == EVENT_UNIT and role.value_kind != "EVENT":
            return f"{role.label} is not an event channel; the 'event' unit applies only to events"
        if source_unit != role.canonical_unit:
            return (
                f"an IDENTITY conversion needs the source unit to be {role.canonical_unit!r}, "
                f"not {source_unit!r}"
            )
        return None

+## Code seams and exact Foundation
+
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. Refuse duplicate directed edges, cycles, orphan connector, more than one parent charger, charger without one feed/meter, and cross-Site links. No stationary battery is implied.

+Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. Current `models.py:ComponentProperty.value` is numeric: extend that typed value to number-or-state and make `foundation_parsing.py:parse_component_properties,render_component_properties` branch only for `ev-connector-enabled`. Its value is the exact string `ENABLED|DISABLED`, unit `state`, kind CONTROL; all preexisting numeric properties keep identical parser/rendered bytes. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.

+## Role set, binding and selected read
+
+Current `binding_roles.py:Role.value_kind` and its conversion validator accept NUMBER/STATE/EVENT, while `CONVERSION_KINDS` is IDENTITY/ENUM. Extend the closed validation to `INTERVAL_DELTA` and `IDENTITY_KWH` only for the `ev_connector_energy` role, preserving old role/conversion behavior and bytes. The W2-00 `(charger-controller,session-event)` and `(connector-controller,fault-event)` tuples already exist with no EV role label; attach their exact EV role labels and add the remaining EV tuples rather than duplicating those keys. The mapping's `requires_session`/connector rules remain the S2 authority.
+

+## Code seams and exact Foundation
+
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. Refuse duplicate directed edges, cycles, orphan connector, more than one parent charger, charger without one feed/meter, and cross-Site links. No stationary battery is implied.
+
+Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. Current `models.py:ComponentProperty.value` is numeric: extend that typed value to number-or-state and make `foundation_parsing.py:parse_component_properties,render_component_properties` branch only for `ev-connector-enabled`. Its value is the exact string `ENABLED|DISABLED`, unit `state`, kind CONTROL; all preexisting numeric properties keep identical parser/rendered bytes. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.
