+## Role set, binding and selected read
+
+Current `binding_roles.py:Role.value_kind` and its conversion validator accept NUMBER/STATE/EVENT, while `CONVERSION_KINDS` is IDENTITY/ENUM. Extend the closed validation to `INTERVAL_DELTA` and `IDENTITY_KWH` only for the `ev_connector_energy` role, preserving old role/conversion behavior and bytes. The W2-00 `(charger-controller,session-event)` and `(connector-controller,fault-event)` tuples already exist with no EV role label; attach their exact EV role labels and add the remaining EV tuples rather than duplicating those keys. The mapping's `requires_session`/connector rules remain the S2 authority.
+
+Extend `sites/binding_roles.py:Role,ROLE_SET_BY_SITE_TYPE,roles_for` with immutable `ev-roles-1`. `ev_session_event` and optional `ev_connector_fault` are EVENT/`event`/IDENTITY per EV_CONNECTOR, one channel each; event kinds and outcomes are the W2-00 v4 allowlist. `ev_connector_state` is STATE/`state`/ENUM per connector, max 60-second cadence with `AVAILABLE|PLUGGED|AUTHORIZING|CHARGING|FAULTED|DISABLED`. `ev_connector_energy` is `INTERVAL_DELTA`/kWh/IDENTITY_KWH per connector, aligned 300-second half-open slots; `ev_connector_power` is optional `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW. `ev_site_import` is `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW ONE per feed and is required only for site-power comparison, not outcome/energy. `ev_requested_power` and `ev_allocated_limit` are optional independent `INTERVAL_MEAN`/kW controller channels. Outcome requires session events; fault association requires fault event; supported energy requires energy meter; service-state context requires status. Use `binding_service.py:validate_bindings,publish,acquisition_snapshot` and `binding_alignment.py` to bind exact registered source/device/signal, asset, unit, conversion, clock/cadence and effective interval. Add only the EV tuples to the closed `contracts/assetops_contracts/source_envelope_v4.py:V4_CHANNEL_MAPPINGS` table; `binding_service.py` supplies the five snapshot metadata keys at a new published revision, following W2-02, not on a historical conversion. Do not let one physical signal silently satisfy incompatible roles. Keep v3 bytes and cold binding snapshots unchanged.
+
+`sites/ev_foundation.py` returns `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` and only the design's eight codes: `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`, `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND`, `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED`, `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. The first six indicate configuration/capability; the last two are separate contact and commissioning notices. The registered Lab Draft gate in `binding_service.py:acquisition_snapshot` must use the selected EV rule rather than mini-grid electrical gaps: block absent connector/feed/limit or required session/status/energy bindings; optional site import/fault/power roles do not block a run that does not claim their capability. A wrong role set or failed effective binding refuses Draft. No test-only gap lift.
+
+Add selected `GET /api/sites/{site_code}/ev/foundation?at=<UTC>` beside the existing cold Foundation router/composition (`rg 'build_cold_foundation_router' backend/assetops_backend`). +## Causal pack and public transform
+
+Register `ev-charger/1` in the closed dispatch used by `host/execution_adapter.py`, `host/lab_execution.py` and simulator kernel, beside `cold-thermal/1`; never use fallback to fuel/mini-grid on unknown identity. Add pure pack under `simulator/assetops_simulator/packs/ev_charger.py` using the neutral `packs/errors.py:PhysicallyUnacceptable`. Start `UNPLUGGED`, no session/fault, 0 kWh. Per UTC minute apply forcing sorted `(time,connector,kind)`, with PLUG before FAULT at equal time. Plug assigns the deterministic scoped session ID; authorization lasts one minute; accepted charging emits START. Denial emits no START. Active fault emits FAULT+ABORT; pre-START fault emits FAULT only. Explicit unplug after active charge and without fault emits END. Grid loss pauses power; it never fabricates ABORT. Clear requires forcing. Available shared kW is `max(0,80-base_load)`, allocated in 1 kW round-robin quanta by connector ID with persistent pointer, bounded by request, connector and charger ratings; exact decimal `energy_next=energy+allocated_kw/60`. Guard every state transition, monotone time, finite nonnegative energy, allocation sum/limits, residual, and one START/terminal per ID. +
+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. The fixture declares both connectors enabled TUESDAY 08:00–16:00, UTC offset 0, for 2026-10-06. Its value is the exact string `ENABLED|DISABLED`, unit `state`, kind CONTROL; all preexisting numeric properties keep identical parser/rendered bytes. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. The fixture declares both connectors enabled TUESDAY 08:00–16:00, UTC offset 0, for 2026-10-06. Reject overlap, reversed/zero interval, ambiguous/nonexistent local instant, disabled connector marked available, and enablement without feed/meter/charger. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.

The first six indicate configuration/capability; the last two are separate contact and commissioning notices. The registered Lab Draft gate in `binding_service.py:acquisition_snapshot` must use the selected EV rule rather than mini-grid electrical gaps: block absent connector/feed/limit or required session/status/energy bindings; optional site import/fault/power roles do not block a run that does not claim their capability. +## Code seams and exact Foundation

+Extend `backend/assetops_backend/sites/models.py:SITE_TYPES,COMPONENT_TYPES,COMPONENT_PROPERTY_DEFINITIONS,TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES,PROPERTY_UNITS`; `foundation_parsing.py:UNIT_RANGES` and its closed parser; `site_parsing.py` Site-type dispatch; `foundation_service.py` validation before publish. Add `EV_CHARGING`, `EV_CHARGER`, `EV_CONNECTOR`. Use the existing `AC_BUS` feed, `METER` import meter, `EV_CHARGER` and `EV_CONNECTOR` distinct component IDs. `TOPOLOGY_NODE_ROLES` gains `CHARGER` and `CONNECTOR`; positions are `AC_BUS:BUS`, `METER:METERING`, charger `CHARGER`, connector `CONNECTOR`. Directed `topology.connections` uses existing `AC` medium for feed→meter→charger and `SIGNAL` for charger→connector; no parallel relation list. +Define properties and carriers exactly: `ev-site-import-limit` kW on `AC_BUS`; `ev-charger-max-power` kW on `EV_CHARGER`; `ev-connector-max-power` kW and `ev-connector-enabled` state on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-meter-resolution` and `ev-meter-error-bound` kWh on `EV_CONNECTOR`; `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` min plus `ev-clock-error-bound` s on `EV_CONNECTOR`. Current `models.py:ComponentProperty.value` is numeric: extend that typed value to number-or-state and make `foundation_parsing.py:parse_component_properties,render_component_properties` branch only for `ev-connector-enabled`. Its value is the exact string `ENABLED|DISABLED`, unit `state`, kind CONTROL; all preexisting numeric properties keep identical parser/rendered bytes. The first three limits, meter resolution/cadences and clock bound are strictly positive finite values; meter error bound nonnegative finite. The selected fixture has feed limit 80 kW, two connector/charger ratings 60 kW, resolution/error bound 0.001 kWh, status cadence 1 min, meter cadence 5 min and clock error bound 30 s. A real Site must author these values; the pack has no silent production default. Schema change `0024_w2_ev_config` follows `0023`, adds the partial `(site_id,session_id,connector_id,source_time,id)` EV measurement index, retains existing Foundation history and 0020 family CHECK. Downgrade refuses with EV measurements, then drops the index while retaining historical Foundation reader safety. No new configuration SQL table.

The fixture declares both connectors enabled TUESDAY 08:00–16:00, UTC offset 0, for 2026-10-06. Reject overlap, reversed/zero interval, ambiguous/nonexistent local instant, disabled connector marked available, and enablement without feed/meter/charger. Selected `at` uses the effective Foundation and binding revision at that instant; a missing selector uses the existing current-selection rule. Older revisions remain selectable and never inherit new limits/schedule. A configured service window is not observed availability.
